title: Project Context
subtitle: Markdown documents this repository carries, plus anything you added here. Attach them to an agent or a skill to put their text in front of the model.

empty.title: No documents yet
empty.body: Put Markdown under .devdigest/specs/, .devdigest/docs/ or .devdigest/insights/ in the repository and press Refresh, or add a document here. Markdown sitting directly under .devdigest/ isn’t picked up — the subfolder is what classifies it.

doc.missingHint: This file is no longer in the repository. It stays attached and is skipped on a run until it comes back.
doc.usedByAgents: {count, plural, =0 {used by no agents} one {used by # agent} other {used by # agents}}

tokens.approximateNote: Token figures are approximate and come from one shared counting scheme, not the review model’s own tokenizer.
tokens.overBudget: Above the {threshold}-token guide. Nothing is blocked — this is a heads-up that the prompt is getting large.

preview.title: Preview
preview.empty: Select a document to read it.
preview.readOnly: Read-only. Edit the file in the repository and press Refresh.

reason.noClone: This repository isn’t cloned locally yet, so nothing could be scanned. Stored documents were left untouched.
reason.bounded: Only the first {kept} documents (by path) are held; {dropped} more were left out.

createModal.title: Add a document
createModal.subtitle: Write it here, or upload a Markdown file. It’s stored in DevDigest, not written back to the repository.
createModal.folderHint: Optional, inside the category. Naming a folder that doesn’t exist yet creates it.

reject.tooLarge: That document is {size} bytes; the limit is {max}.

delete.confirm: Delete {name}? It was added here, so nothing in the repository changes.
delete.repoOwned: This document was discovered in the repository. Remove the file there and press Refresh.

attach.title: Project context
attach.orderHint: Order matters — a document earlier in this list appears earlier in the assembled ## Project context block. Toggle to attach.
attach.skillHint: Any agent using this skill inherits these documents.
attach.reorder: Drag to reorder, or focus and press Arrow Up / Arrow Down
attach.trustLine: Injected as an untrusted block (## Project context) into every run of this agent in this repository.
attach.serializesNote: These paths join the agent’s own ## Project context block — a skill never gets a section of its own, and a document’s text is never part of the skill body.

noRepo.title: Pick a repository first
noRepo.body: Documents belong to a repository, while agents and skills are workspace-wide. Choose a repository in the sidebar to attach its documents.
